name: How does a GEO website audit differ from a general SEO audit?
description: A GEO audit focuses specifically on local search ranking factors, while a general SEO audit covers overall search visibility.

mainEntity.name: How does a GEO website audit differ from a general SEO audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a general SEO audit focuses on overall search engine visibility, a GEO website audit specifically hones in on factors influencing local search rankings. It deeply analyzes elements like Google My Business optimization, local citation consistency, geo-targeted content, and local schema markup, which are less emphasized in a broad SEO audit. A GEO audit aims to attract customers in specific physical locations, whereas general SEO targets a wider, non-location-specific audience.
